changeSet.author: devops
changeSet.comment: Create token_usage_limit table for per-user monthly/total token limits
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE token_usage_limit ( id BIGINT GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY, user_hash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, limit_month BIGINT NOT NULL, limit_total BIGINT NOT NULL, version INT NOT NULL, created TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(), updated TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(), CONSTRAINT pk_token_usage_limit PRIMARY KEY (id), CONSTRAINT uq_token_usage_limit_user_version UNIQUE (user_hash, version) );

changeSet.author: devops
changeSet.comment: Create campaign_token_usage table for per-character token consumption tracking

rollback.sql: DROP INDEX IF EXISTS idx_campaign_token_usage_user_hash; DROP TABLE IF EXISTS campaign_token_usage;
